author: resepignev
body:
Resistance 


Title: Resistance
Created By: Running_Boy_12
Game: DTM (Nebula)
Teams: Light (White) vs Shadow (Black)
Details: Small map with fast paced gameplay. Only a little bit of Iron is included at the back of the map, so choose wisely what you going to craft. There is also gold so if the iron runs out you still can craft armor. Actually there is some kind treasure in the middle, fight for it and you'll win the game!
